input.questions: All 241 unchanged public questions; existing one-draw development rules only. Preserve each failure; no regeneration.
input.pairs: Complete Cartesian product of both emails and all 241 questions: 482 per method.
input.html: Decode the saved complete main HTML UTF-8 bytes without newline rewriting. No fallback excerpts, attachments, external links or cross-email aggregation. Missing main HTML remains unscorable.
input.qwen: Use the final selected study's sealed email_packet, judge_request, local_call, valid_judgment and settlement helpers, with its frozen semantic renderer and runtime. Each input contains the full semantic email and one existing rule; no labels, pair IDs, question ordinals, excerpts or review notes.
input.regex: Use unchanged round4 selected-baseline generations and the exact sealed matcher.py/round2_matcher.py byte-level adapter on full main HTML. Preserve invalid patterns, timeouts, two matches and source byte offsets. This measures lexical candidates, not settlement authorization.

metadata.subject: Preserve full source subject as untrusted subject metadata.
metadata.signer: Require an earlier intake result exactly pass, algorithm rsa-sha256, nonempty domain and selector, no body-length limitation, unique matching domain/selector metadata, identical normalized signed-header lists, offline full-body hash match and recorded raw/decoded-body integrity checks. Expose a signing domain only when the validated candidates have one unique domain. Ambiguous signature linkage is unresolved; do not choose the first or derive signer from display From/proof.
metadata.signedDate: Expose source.messageDate only if an eligible signature covers Date and the raw email contains exactly one Date header whose timezone-aware timestamp equals source.messageDate. Otherwise expose an empty signedDate and retain the ambiguity in the audit. A mismatch halts validation.
metadata.receivedAt: Preserve mailbox receipt timestamp separately. Neither receipt nor signed message date establishes the event date.
metadata.verification: Preserve original intake pass observation and its checkedAt timestamp. The evaluator does not repeat RSA/DNS verification. An offline body hash alone is insufficient. Provenance is not factual truth or original-rule eligibility.

prediction.indexMapping: A is original outcomeLabels index 0; B is index 1. Verify every question is binary.
prediction.qwenFactual: Use factualOutcome exactly, with no heuristic repair.
prediction.qwenStrict: YES/NO independently for A and B: only A YES -> A, only B YES -> B, both NO -> NEITHER, both YES -> CONFLICT. Both NO and both YES remain unsettled.
prediction.regex: The same two-match mask maps to A/B/NEITHER/CONFLICT. Compare its factual candidates and provisional original-rule admissibility separately, without claiming the matcher enforces full rules.
prediction.failures: Unavailable rules, invalid patterns, timeout, over-context requests, malformed/capped local answers and transport failures are UNSCORABLE, never NEITHER.
prediction.preflight: Count every available full request with the pinned loaded model and actual template. Record overflow per row and never truncate. Verify model artifact fields and context. No inference during preflight.
prediction.inference: Four local workers, isolated requests grouped by full email packet hash then market ID. One request per available pair per unique method. No retries, resampling, best-of, shared history, or interleaved runtime experiments. Reuse only fully recorded identical completed requests on explicit resume; an interrupted started request blocks for reconciliation.

scoring.core: supported_direct and supported_inferred require their recorded A/B index. Report these groups separately. unsupported expects NEITHER, indicating this email does not establish a target fact. This is not a negative market resolution.
scoring.strict: admissible requires its recorded A/B index; unsupported expects NEITHER. Preserve missing conditions and other output fields unchanged. No posthoc quote, missing-condition or factual-agreement gate changes decisions.
scoring.uncertainty: ambiguous and unreviewed are excluded from indexed accuracy denominators, but retain all rows, decision counts, failures and exclusive/conflicting claims. nonbinary is also separate; no conversion to an indexed outcome or automatic credit for a named nonbinary resolution.
scoring.quotes: Report exact nonempty substring presence in the complete model-visible semantic body as an additional diagnostic. It is not an entailment or authenticity test.
scoring.denominators: Report full category denominators, completed category denominators, and common-completed pairs across methods. Failure is not credited as abstention. Include exclusive claims and any A/B predicate claim, including CONFLICT, on unsupported evidence.
scoring.dependence: Show results by email as well as pooled pairs. These are two independent source documents, not 482 independent samples; public questions are existing development questions. Do not estimate population or all-Polymarket accuracy.
scoring.annotations: Validate all 482 rows, original question/rule hashes, Unicode evidence spans and source identities. Single-author provisional labels are not human-verified settlement gold. No correction based on candidate outputs. Read labels for scoring only after candidate calls have finished.

openingGates: Final Qwen selection and every captured file hash verify.
The original Qwen independent test's 48 Astra draws are frozen and verified.
Regex selected baseline, source copies and all captured artifacts verify.
This protocol, procedure, all evaluator source/dependencies and fixed candidate-rule links are frozen before reading reserved sources.
Reservation seal, every source file, annotation file and unchanged public-list hashes verify.
afterOpening: No optimization, method selection, threshold adjustment or live promotion based on this reservation. Preserve failures and annotate any necessary execution repair as a separate artifact without changing the frozen procedure or predictions.
